description: Lossless content-addressed evidence. Original bytes define object IDs; XZ objects preserve raw logs/JSON/manifests/source/frames without normalization. Identical bytes are stored once.
scope: One rejected per-row glyph-baseline reuse variant. Prewarmed Linux CPU damage/repaint measurements; no claim about every implementation of this technique.
